runtime: Existing pinned Windows CPython3.11.9/CT2 4.8.2 CPU dependencies from ../marian-model-qa
conversion: Separate sanitize and convert processes. Official ZIP torch weights_only/mmap path to sharded safetensors, then CT2 int8. Build RAM/disk preflight is separate from inference budgets.
routes: EN/JA/KO/ZH directly to EN or ZH; source-only bypass; no English pivot
tokens: M2M100Tokenizer.src_lang supplies source language token plus EOS; per-row CT2 target_prefix is lang_code_to_token[target]. Verify and remove the returned target prefix, require final EOS, then decode.
chineseScript: Official model has zh only, no Hans-specific token. Simplified-Chinese script and semantics must be reviewed in actual unmodified outputs; no automatic script-compliance claim.
routingLimit: Known fixture language labels; automatic source detection untested
validation: Original fixed screen IDs first; technical failure skips larger fixtures. Then frozen full48/holdout cold and warm, source-only, actual decode cancellation. Technical success does not imply semantic screen approval.
holdoutLimit: Frozen original holdout retained unmodified; it is now a known benchmark across candidates. A new independently frozen holdout is required later, before final adoption.

quality.blockers: Wrong target language, foreign copy, clear overall meaning reversal
